scenes.heading: How photosynthesis works
scenes.subheading: How plants turn light into food
scenes.narration: Welcome! Today we will learn how photosynthesis works. It is how green plants make their own food from sunlight.

scenes.heading: What a plant needs
scenes.narration: A plant needs three things. First, light from the sun. Second, water from the soil, and third, carbon dioxide from the air.

scenes.heading: The air cycle
scenes.narration: Inside the leaf, green chlorophyll uses sunlight to turn carbon dioxide into glucose, the plant's food. This also makes oxygen, which animals and people breathe in. We breathe out carbon dioxide, and plants take it in again, so the cycle goes on.

scenes.heading: Recap
scenes.subheading: Sunlight, water and air become food
scenes.narration: To recap, plants use sunlight, water and carbon dioxide to make glucose. They also give us the oxygen we breathe. Next time you see a green leaf, remember photosynthesis!
